checks.message: Official redline is unavailable; the package repeatedly labels the rough geometry and blocks statutory use.
Three key-area polygons are provisional and require complete recomputation when replaced.
Participant-generated land-use polygons partition the submitted provisional site without material gaps or overlaps.
Site, building, green and public-space values were recomputed in EPSG:4548 from submitted geometry.
Public scenarios avoid personal dietary profiling and automated food-safety decisions, remain manually operable, and assume no confirmed partners or personal data.
Twelve scenario cards include four controlled food-tech industry studios and seven personas.
Static HTML uses local assets only and contains no forms, tracking or remote dependencies.
Readable chapters reference standards, depth items, data layers, metrics, sources and assumptions.
